mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, the resulting supply constraints and inflationary pressures compress corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales figure (RSAFS above 400,000) indicates robust consumer spending, which is a leading indicator of corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.25% in a single month) signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both employment growth (PAYEMS) and a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of persistent low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the combination of low inflation and low rates supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low rate regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.
